textual.context: Presented as a promotion based on the speaker's account of receiving unusually high credit; the speaker attributes discovery to someone on Twitter and expresses uncertainty about how it works.
textual.potential_relevance: The unusually large promised credit is directly linked to using a supplied link/code, submitting information, signing up, and making a qualifying purchase, creating a concrete reward-and-request relationship for later assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the code works, whether the link is authorized, what information is collected, whether any credit was actually received, or whether the stated amount is available to other users.
